model.name: TTS Fish Drama 3 Small (Streaming)
model.description: Built with Fish Audio. Community pruned and distilled IQ3 Drama 3 for English and Japanese speech and voice cloning. Uses a separate, pinned audio.cpp runtime and bounded streaming decode. Delivery and pronunciation can differ from the full model.
model.selector_help: 10.46 GB GGUF download plus a native CUDA runtime on first use. Streaming limits codec memory growth; smaller GPUs cache selected experts for GPU calculation. Voice references must be 1–30 seconds. Lower VRAM does not guarantee faster generation. This community derivative supports English and Japanese; the full Fish model remains available.
